To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the five representative styles of leadership are significantly associated with personality traits of big five model.

The results of our study suggest that there is a significant difference between the five personality dimensions and the five leadership styles in terms of their means, standard deviations, and variances.
there are five representative styles of leadership and these styles have different relationships with the five personality dimensions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
exploring the link between leadership style and personality traits.
the development of a coherent link between personality and representative leadership styles.
the relationship between personality dimensions and leadership styles in order to develop a comprehensive model of leadership styles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the personality dimensions of openness, extraversion and conscientiousness have significant positive relationship with all five representative leadership styles while agreeableness and neuroticism are negatively related with all five representative styles.
leadership styles and personality are interrelated and that personality traits can be used to predict leadership styles.
the personality dimensions of openness to experience and agreeableness are significantly associated with all the representative styles of leadership.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the representative leadership style of transactional leadership is positively related to extraversion, agreeableness and conscientiousness.

the leadership style of transformational leadership is most related to extraversion, conscientiousness, and openness to experience; transactional leadership is related to conscientiousness and agreeableness; laissez-faire leadership style is related to conscientiouness, openness to experience, agreeableness, and neuroticism; autocratic leadership style is related with conscientiousness, openness to experience and neuroticism and democratic leadership style is related mostly with extraversion and conscientiousness.

there is a strong positive relationship between leadership style of transformational and personality traits of extraversion, openness and conscientiousness and there is a strong negative relationship between leadership style and personality trait of neuroticism.
The main takeaway from our work is that
leadership style and personality are two sides of the same coin.
the personality trait of openness to experience is the most significant predictor of leadership styles followed by conscientiousness.

the five representative styles are significantly different on each of the five personality traits and that the relationship of these representative leadership styles to the five personality dimensions is not consistent across different styles.
